_comment: Divider test at 0.3 m for the second pair (unit 3 in A, unit 1 in B): a thin black strip stands between the sensor windows, kept out of both fields of view, checking whether any extra ambient in the AB runs collapses to the solo level (crosstalk goes sensor-to-sensor) or survives (it arrives via the target). Two angles only (2 and 5 degrees per side, this mount only does whole degrees), both zones, five repeats, same design as the 0.6 m and 0.8 m divider tests, same calibration as rq3_jessica_0p3_pair13.json. Run with --tag divider. Run: python -m rig session --guided --port COM7 --config configs/rq3_jessica_0p3_pair13_divider.json --out data --tag divider
name: rq3-jessica-0p3-pair13-divider
